lines.t: Behold, before the sixth seal is broken, I shall deal to the hard-hearted a glancing blow: One shall be taken,
For the innocent shall be taken, and the upright in heart shall be hidden,
as many as receive My words and also do them.
Behold, even those asleep in Messiah shall come forth,
and they too shall be gone from this place,
The earth shall starve, all light gathered and taken,
darkness, thick clouds and darkness, the Great and Terrible Day of The Lord."
